text: I enjoyed the first game immensely and this was... alright. It lost a lot of what the first game had going for it. The art was very good, like usual which was awesome. The boss fights were rather bland and the gunplay was great if i didnt have to reload every 10 seconds or switch weapons because I already ran out of my very limited ammo. I got it significantly discounted in a game bundle so I can't complain about the price but I definitely wouldn't get it unless it was on sale.

(SPOILER ALERT)    the combat and especially the movent is good but i wish the story was longer for me peronally if the story was longer it would have given me more time to be better friends with BT but at the ending where BT sacrificied himself i felt a little bit but not much. 9/10
Lacks the flow of the first game, wich was the main thing that made it so good. Very frustrating level design, far to many guns for my taste.
Given the age of the game it still holds up surprisingly well, mainly due to the continuous love it seems to receive from the developers. Movement is fun and the stealth is satisfying.

Very impressed with how good this feels to play. From the Directional Air Dash to the Parries everything feels very crisp and great to control. The animation work on enemies is genuinely outstanding as well. Attacks are very intuitive to read and don't require you to just learn patterns by memory. The very high quality on most animations does make it noticeable when something isn't quite at the same level (the death animation when you fall in a pit for example), but I think speaks more so to how well everything else is done when something sticks out by just being 'okay'.

Gorgeous Metroidvania with great game feel. Big thumbs up!
garfield kart. oh garfield kart. i love you
Smooth moves and satisfying combat made this quick 100% really fun. Seems like a good speedrun game too. Reminds me of Shovel Knight which is one of my all time faves so its really good.

Solid game, but not a lot of content.

Decent roadmap, but the last few updates have been extremely underwhelming. 

Hopefully it picks up!
all i know is pain and suffering and that Tristan will find a way to blow us all up before the day ends

Second playthrough and another 40 hours well spent.

The story, characters and gameplay are phenomenal. The prologue sucks you in immediately and there's not a dull moment the rest of the way. Maybe some of the camp scenes don't hit as hard as the first time, but nothing to complain about. 

I had an easier time with the combat this time around. Bosses that gave me a hard time on my first playthrough (primarily the end of Act 2), went down with ease this time. Ton of fun building your team.

The music still hits and the amount of times I still play Lumiere over and over again at the camp is embarrassing. 

Nitpick: character mouth movement doesn't match up with dialogue, but hey, it's a $40 game. What're you gonna do. 

Still a Masterpiece 10/10

A decent video game, but not to die for, and...the PC port is problematic without special patches to fix graphical issues on a Linux Ubuntu PC like mine.

My advice? There are better stealth-based video games than this; this game doesn't really feel like a masterpiece.
really good but has a lot of missed elements and stiffness with some heros
Cute game. Quirky. Decent story if not a little thin. Fully playable with controller. Short but felt pretty satisfying to beat. Would play a sequel.
unless you have the time, the will, and the ability to deal with difficulty on par with eldenring ng+ 20(without any levels or powerful equipment). then just buy eldenring.
Really enjoyed playing this game. Very chill vibe. The music is phenomenal - I had myself adding so many new tracks to my Spotify playlist. A great litte story as well. 9/10
one of the best platformers of all time.
IT IS NOT A GOOD AS THE FIRST TWO BUT IT IS STILL FUN
Amazing gameplay Amazing music Amazing art but please let us have the fishing minigame it would be so so funny

What to say at this point? 
It is a wonderful game: great art, grat music, fun gameplay, outstanding atmosphere. If I had to nitpick on something it would be the shooting mechanics, not the best out there, specially if you play with a controller it is hard the be accurate with it. But yeah the game is fun as hell.
You have to try it at least once in oyur life.

A solid arpg with soulslike elements. The combat is satisfying and heavy. Dodging is snappy and parrying as well. If you're a fan of Titan Quest and Marvel Ultimate Alliance this should be up your alley.

I was looking forward to this DLC to blew me away. Sadly, it did not deliver even though im a fan of the mafia series. To be completely honest, the two chapters that this DLC presents, is the most boring of the whole story. However, the jobs and challenges in free ride mode is the strong point for this DLC. I really liked the challenges, it makes the game loop fun, and it is what brings me back to the game every while. This type of content what should have been in every mafia game for the free ride mode by default. Looking forward to more interesting DLCs like this that hopefully will enhance the game replayability even more.

Incredibly smooth and satisfying gun play, with punishing but rewarding difficulty, everything feels perfect from the perks, to the guns, to the melee + gunplay and the rhythm.

Personally I'd recommend binding slide/crouch to right click and melee attack + throw to secondary mouse buttons. 

I really wish more games had such flawless gun play/combat mechanics.

I like it a lot because the game managed to find the balance between souls frustraring souls difficulty and story based casuallity. Fights are perfect and feels cool. I like the battle system. The game rewards you for exploring

General Overview: AMAZING Story. I was engaged throughout my entire playthrough. The atmosphere was impeccable too and the boss fights were all very memorable. I would highly recommend this game. The visuals are great as well. There were genuinely moments in this game where I stopped and just looked at the environment. The gameplay mechanics are not complicated and not revolutionary. They fit the game and the story that is being told and that is perfectly fine!

Story: 10/10
Gameplay: 8/10
Music: 10/10
Visuals: 50/10 THEY COOKED WITH THE ART DIRECTION
Bugs: None that I could find in my playthrough. It was smooth sailing for me.
Performance: No performance issues for me.

sometimes this game is extremely silly with its story and realism but by far the most fun, enjoyable and visually stunning of the new tr reboot games. please for the love of god turn on the reduced screen shake from the start what is it with these games and the motion sickness. i think this is the prettiest and coolest lara we ever had and i will miss her :(
insanely addictive. I wasn't sure about the aesthetic tbh, but the charm is undeniable.
Super fun game with lots of variety of builds and playstyles, would 100% recommend. It also has a really cool story and unique character designs.

The game definitely has the potential, but the developers must fix some design issues, for example add a map and normal way to save the game instead of checkpoints. Replaying the same area many times is simply annoying.

what a touching story about living, breathing people on both sides of a war led by opportunistic morons. what a pity vichy-ass ubisoft execs entirely missed the point and ended up banning it in the wrong country for the wrong people.

Well Dweller is another one of Kyle Thompson's masterpieces. If you're a fan of metroidvanias then you need to play Well Dweller.

I played this entirely on my Steam Deck OLED and it was a great experience. Highly recommend playing this on an OLED screen if you can.

Only negative thing I found was the game is really easy, especially when in combat. It's kind of hard to die during combat and you can eat like 10 bullets and then after 5 seconds you regen all your health. The gameplay was great though and so was the ending.

My life has been sucked away by this addicting and amazing game. 5 stars, no complaints, besides the fact that i cannot purchase avatars in the Steam Points Shop. I am devastated. We could have had villager avatars, Junimos, our boy Krobus, anything. 

Anyway, buy this game, you will only regret the fact that you did not buy it sooner.

One of the things I loved most about the game was the progression. It felt very natural and like there was a lot to it. It also has a lot of content not including any DLC. The combat also felt really expressive and gives you a lot of options with what weapon you can use. The music in it is also some of my favorite in games just because of how chill it is. I really like the game and thank my main man Julio Nacho for getting it for me.

It may seem ridiculous to say, especially since I haven't played this game in over a year now, but this game is a life changing experience to play. I may have moved on for now, gotten busy, but I am sure in years to come I will come back to play this game a hundred more times. It is the only game that I can factually say has and will never be boring to play. Thank you Re-logic, you are true heroes
The game is a really good way to play the original Half Life for newcomers to the series. It is really great, until you get to Xen, it is very pretty, and very boring.

In my mind this is one of those 10/10 games.
They took everything that was fantastic about the original, and refined it with 20 year more advanced technology.
Graphics are beautiful, story is engaging, gameplay is satisfying.
It has a really good balance of mechanics, so you're advancing in skill but it doesn't feel like grinding as you get breaks to do other things too.

Red Dead Redemption 2 

10/10 — What a  journey.

100+ hours, and I never got bored for even a second. It is easily one of the greatest game of all time. Don't know how to write a perfect review about this game but boy just buy this game and play it. Every single penny and second spent in this game is totally worth.

Fishing while drinking beer and gambling?! Hell yes!

The game is a little buggy, but in a funny and goofy way. I knew what I was signing up for the moment I bought the game, but playing it was still a pleasant surprise because the game is AWESOME! The thing I enjoyed the most was the DRIP FISH designs: they’re all super quirky and clever!

And the friendly fire was... great :D

A controversial remaster. The combat system and visuals have been improved, but the blindingly bright sunlight is genuinely unpleasant, and the new “Yoda-style lightsabers” from the updated combat effects look completely out of place in The Witcher 3.

These effects seriously hurt the visual atmosphere for me. I would like to see proper options to disable the glowing sword effects and tone down the excessive brightness.

I am leaving a negative review until these issues are addressed. The underlying game is still The Witcher 3, but these new visual choices make the remaster worse for me.
One of my favs. Loved the gameplay and open world, and story was great imo!

This game was fun but I got stuck on the mission 9 infinite loading glitch. So I wasted money because I missed out on 6 missions. I have this game on xbox, my advice for someone wanting to play this game is play it on xbox or playstation not on pc.

Peak game.

Great game, was really fun playing it, i thought the game would be bad but it wasn't. Recommended!

Such a meaningful artpiece. A beautiful visual representation of going through different phases. Joyful exploration, falling into the deep, losing your way, finding light and the cycle that continues. 

Yes, it is just 2 hours of gameplay, but that is where it's strength is at in my opinion. I adore the simplicity and the way you can experience the whole arc in just one session without having to take breaks. I return to this game every year or two, and everytime it resonates with me in a new and profound way. Genuinely thankful this game exists.

just like the first one, the basic setup remains the same rats, kingdoms, and wars but i loved this one much more i found it more fun, in this game, we can use powers granted by divine pillars that appear as you progress for instance, you might gain a power after defeating a boss or even in the middle of a level. You can craft more items and there is a wider variety of armor  i bought the DLC, and it was absolutely incredible. RECOMENDED!!!
